name: Carnacage III — World Heavyweight Title Match

date.source: The fed's own served recap's own dateline, Cedar Rapids, Iowa; a separate title-history page instead dates the same event "December 26th".

matches.note: The WWC World Heavyweight Title match, billed "Sex & Violence Friends Collide": Disturbed Youth (defending, challenged by his own Sex and Violence partner and four-time former champion Shane Stud) loses the title to a belly-to-belly suplex pinfall at 31:17. Full blow-by-blow served verbatim; both men shake hands after.

notes: Part 8 of an eleven-part Carnacage III broadcast, billed "the last ever Carnacage." "The Franchise" Shane Stud defeats Disturbed Youth to regain the WWC World Heavyweight Title he had lost to Youth in a Three Way Dance weeks earlier — his own fifth recorded reign, and the 18th and last reign the held record attests on this title's own chain (see /titles/uga-wwc-world-heavyweight.html).

A WWC World Television Title match. Frat Boy, suspended from his own scheduled referee assignment, came out anyway and counted a pinfall for Kelly — the fed's own recap hedges the outcome twice ("apparently") and records Kelly's own on-screen confusion at the result.

matches.note: The winner takes home $1,000,000 and a title shot of any title, at any time. Thirty men entered; the fed's own recap names only fourteen of them (the fourteen who advanced past the first level) and seven of those fourteen advanced past the second — the sixteen unnamed first-level entrants are a genuine gap in the held text, not guessed here. Rancid unlocks a chest atop the third level with three keys (one stolen from Chainsaw Charlie, one from Frantic, one already his own) to win; Chainsaw Charlie then kicks the ladder out from under him after the win is already academic, a spot with no bearing on the result. Grendel's own unconscious body is described lying on the third level throughout — the fed's own commentary itself hedges on whether to count him among the men present ("Actually eight, if you include Grendel!") — read here as a leftover detail from his earlier post-match attack rather than as a claim that he was an active entrant, and he carries no appearances row on this match for that reason.

notes: Part 11 of the same eleven-part Carnacage III broadcast — the closing recap, structuring both the full undercard (results narrated in past tense) and the live blow-by-blow of the Carnacage structure match's own final two levels. The WWC World Heavyweight Title match this same recap also summarizes ("Shane Stud defeated Disturbed Youth...") is the full subject of a separate served part of the same broadcast (promotions/uga/archive/carnacage-8.html) and is not duplicated here. One in-fiction authority-figure angle — Jon Massey coming out to make an announcement, interrupted by Eric Davidson and Kevin Beck's false confession and JaMeS RioT's reveal — is narrated in prose only; per this wing's own privacy provenance note, whether "Jon Massey" reads as an in-fiction persona or an out-of-fiction operator credit is genuinely ambiguous, so no character row is minted for the name here even though his every in-fiction appearance stands unredacted.
